versions.changelog:
Summary: Documentation restructured and simplified for users; detailed setup moved to INSTALL.md; operational guide and widget documentation improved.

- Removed the readme file (README.md) and consolidated its key content.
- SKILL.md rewritten to focus on operations, widgets, tasks, and avatar creation, minimizing install/setup details.
- Installation and setup instructions moved out (referenced as INSTALL.md) for clarity.
- Widget markup and usage guide expanded with syntax, options, and best practices.
- Task panel and avatar creation sections streamlined for easier reference.
- All in-depth technical setup and edge cases omitted for a cleaner, more user-friendly update.

Initial release of ClawTime — webchat interface for OpenClaw with passkey auth, 3D avatars, and voice mode.

- Provides step-by-step setup including install, configuration, and custom avatar creation.
- Supports server-side voice transcription using Whisper (with browser STT fallback).
- Includes instructions to configure agent name, emoji, and theme.
- Default 3D avatar is customizable; detailed sample code and tips are provided.
- Requires gateway token setup for connection to OpenClaw backend.
